questionsToConsider: Do you sell to both consumers and businesses, or can you drop one path entirely?
Which customer details would change a decision, such as company size, role or age?
Which alternatives do customers really weigh you against, including doing nothing?
Should this go to every customer, or to recent buyers only while the decision is fresh?
guide.howToUseResponses: Group the responses by buyer type and then by the main reason people chose you; those groups are a far better starting point for personas than demographics alone. Read the problem answers for the words customers use, and reuse that language in your marketing. Where many people considered doing nothing, your real competitor is inertia, and your messaging should explain why acting now is worth it.
customizeSteps: Remove the business or consumer path if you only sell to one, and edit the company size bands to fit your market.
Replace the reason list with the strengths you think win customers, and keep an Other option to catch the ones you missed.
Send it to recent customers, then sort the answers by buyer type in the dashboard or export them to CSV.

faqs.q: What is a customer analysis survey?
faqs.a: It asks your customers who they are, what problem they had, what they considered and why they chose you. It adds the reasons behind purchases to what your sales data already shows.

faqs.q: What questions should a customer analysis survey include?
faqs.a: Background that matters to your market, how they found you, the problem they were solving, the alternatives they weighed, the main reason they chose you and how well you meet their needs.

faqs.q: Can I use this for building buyer personas?
faqs.a: Yes. Grouping answers by buyer type, problem and reason for choosing you gives you personas based on what customers said rather than guesses.

faqs.q: How is customer analysis different from a satisfaction survey?
faqs.a: A satisfaction survey asks how well you're doing. Customer analysis asks who your customers are and why they bought, so you can find and serve more people like them.
